unsupported: Unsupported repository: docker/jvm/Dockerfile exposes port 9092 (Kafka), so the image is a database or message-broker server that clients reach over its own protocol, not a web application.
Persistent local filesystem storage is not supported

findings.message: Unsupported repository: docker/jvm/Dockerfile exposes port 9092 (Kafka), so the image is a database or message-broker server that clients reach over its own protocol, not a web application.
Persistent local filesystem storage is not supported

The Dockerfile copies server.properties, resources/common-scripts, which the repository does not contain (a build step makes it before docker build). Deployz builds from the repository only. Add a Dockerfile that builds the app from source, or select another Dockerfile.
